name: Importer-Exporter Code (IEC)
description: Primary registration code mandated by Directorate General of Foreign Trade for any cross-border commercial shipments.

required_documents: Cancelled cheque or bank certificate of the current account
Digital Signature Certificate or Aadhaar for e-signing
metadata.statutory_fee: Application fee as notified by DGFT
application_steps: Register on the DGFT portal with PAN and mobile verification
Attach PAN, bank proof and address proof
e-Sign and pay the application fee
Download the IEC certificate once issued
